The validation only tests fileHeader.getFileName(), while checkOutputDirectoryStructure and the subsequent extraction use outPath plus newFileName. A caller-controlled newFileName such as '../../evil.txt' can therefore escape the extraction directory even when the archive entry name is benign."}]}
